fixes: Preserve transverse direction and azimuth in getangles near a beam axis.
Evaluate CM velocities and cosines from explicit spatial vectors, avoiding sqrt(1-m^2/E^2) cancellation at a massive threshold.
Use stable massless light-cone arithmetic and rationalized positive recoil expressions in local FI/ISR forward and inverse maps.
Use the accurate Lorentz dot product and direct positive quark energy fraction in sborncol_fsr, avoiding a small invariant being snapped to zero.
Apply legacy inverse guards after the massless stable branch; guard the stable value that is actually used.
Compute the small ISR recoil light-cone component as a positive complementary ratio, avoiding fm-xi*qminus cancellation.

limitations: Finite sampled validation is not a proof for every floating-point endpoint.
The controlled inclusive uncertainty is about one pb; it is a regression/closure check, not a replacement for the requested production integrations.
Rejection frequency does not bound a cross-section bias. The final check therefore tests the inclusive result as well as all numerical diagnostic families.
No warning was suppressed and no reconstruction tolerance was loosened by this validation.
The remaining maxjetflavor warning in the copied old cards is the automatic 4-to-5 correction; the runtime setting is already five light flavours.
